boot: Outside, nobody answers. The map is blank.
We don't know what's out there. Open CREW, then [MAP], and send someone to scout.
reconnect: You're back. {elapsed} since your last shift.
The generator is still humming. Nobody called.
At the dial again. It's been {elapsed} since you sat here.
Through the speakers, only white noise.

help: sound          turns sound on or off
notifications  turns notifications on or off
[ RADIO ] dial and decoding · [ BUNKER ] power, workshop, modules · [ CREW ] your scouts and the [MAP].

expedition.dispatched: {name} heads out to {zone}. Expected back in: {eta}.
expedition.returnedWithLoot: {name} is back at the bunker. Brought: {loot}.
expedition.returnedEmpty: {name} is back at the bunker empty-handed.
expedition.deathNotice: {name}'s channel is still open. Only static.

bunker.talkCooldown: {name} doesn't feel like talking right now. Try again in {hours} h.
bunker.conversationExpired: {name} doesn't want to talk about it anymore.
bunker.foodLow: Rations for about {days} days. Someone should go looking for food.
bunker.foodOut: The rations ran out. Everyone at home is hungry: stress is rising and wounds heal slower.
bunker.foodBack: There's food again. The bunker breathes easier.

radio.orderDelayed: Order sent. Because of the distance, it takes {delay} to arrive.
radio.survivorFound: There's someone out there: {name}, at {zone}. Asking to be rescued.
radio.transmissionFound: Encrypted transmission picked up. Waiting to be decoded.
radio.alreadyCaught: You already picked up that signal.
radio.decodeWrong: That doesn't make sense. Keep trying.
radio.intelCache: Intel: there's a stash at {zone}. The next expedition there will look for it.
radio.intelDanger: Intel: you know the dangers at {zone}. The next expedition there goes better prepared.
radio.morseTableUnlocked: It was a ham radio manual. You can now check the Morse table while decoding.
radio.rescueFailed: The rescue of {name} is still pending.
radio.rosterFull: No free bunks. You need room before rescuing anyone else.
radio.relayMaintained: The relay at {zone} has been repaired.
radio.relayFailing: The relay at {zone} stopped working. It needs maintenance.
radio.assistantCaught: {name} picked up a signal while you were away.

base.badAir: The filters can't keep up. The air is getting heavy.
base.raidRepelled: Someone tried to get into the bunker. {guards} drove them back.
base.raidLost: They got into the bunker. They took: {loot}.
base.raidInjured: {name} took a beating defending the bunker.
base.craftNoSlot: No free workbenches in the workshop.
base.unequipped: {name} left their gear in the bunker.
base.reserveLow: The power reserve isn't enough to lock onto the signal.
base.gearWorn: {name}'s {gear} is falling apart ({condition}%). Repair it in the bunker.
base.gearBroken: {name}'s {gear} broke. It does nothing until it's repaired.
base.gearRepaired: The {gear} is as good as new.
base.mapScouted: {name} came back from the {direction} ({band}). It's on the map now.
base.mapNothing: Nothing worth a trip out there. At least now we know.
base.mapHeard: Something on the radio from the {direction} ({band}). Worth scouting.
